   reached through: run:62 > process_row:41
   At line 41 the p300_single_gen2 is asked to draw 5 ul, below its minimum of 20 ul (this
   line did it 500 times). A pipette cannot measure less than its minimum: it draws the
   wrong amount, or nothing, and the volumes in this protocol only add up on paper. The
   simulator passes the move. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 2 more in slot
   3.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 2 more in slot 3.
   Fix: Use a pipette whose range covers the volume (a p20 for 1 to 20 ul), or scale the
   reaction so every volume is at least the pipette's minimum.
